audit_method: Text extraction was used to locate candidate pages.
Every page cited below was rendered from the source PDF and visually inspected.
The audit compares only published surface syntax with the consolidated EBNF; it is not a parser implementation or a semantic-validation result.

reserved_words.finding: The language reference reserves many Part IV statement leaders, including rail, dial, spec, constraint, sequence, route, derate, monitor, alert, hold, use, force_state, on, charge, discharge, refresh, scan, and select.

additional_statement_forms.finding: The prose tables describe select, scan, interrupt, and a verification sublanguage, and expressly say a form missing from the appendix should be treated as an erratum.

consolidated_ebnf.finding: The consolidated structural EBNF omits the additional reserved statement families that the reference corpus uses.

reference_boards.reason: The published board body contains forms other than layer_decl or via_decl.
The observed statement leaders can fit the published circuit-item/component prefixes. Full parsing and semantic conformance remain untested.
